rights.evidence: Narrow research-benchmark evaluation of the authors' publicly offered native release. The official project page (https://dreamdragon.github.io/PennAction/) and archive README invite dataset use and request citation of Zhang, Zhu and Derpanis, ICCV 2013. This record is an assistant review of that offered research use, not a grant of new rights or commercial clearance. Publish aggregate error/coverage and provenance only; do not redistribute the source archive, original images, native labels, or converted labels.

pixel_origin_evidence: The original tools/CreatePointLightDisplay.m rounds annotation.x/y and passes them directly to MATLAB sub2ind(dims,Y,...X...,T), without adding one. tools/visualize.m displays the resulting raster alongside the original frame. We therefore interpret native coordinates as one-based image pixel centres and subtract one once. No origin is tuned against predictions.
annotation_provenance: Authors' native Penn Action 2D labels and visibility flags, with the published 13-joint ordering. Before this native inference run, an assistant visually inspected the first/middle/last source frame of every selected sequence (36 diagnostic frames) for order, geometry, apparatus and annotation alignment. This is format/sample review independent of the model, not expert relabelling or individual adjudication of every frame. Preserve all native labels and literal joint names; omit the non-equivalent head point. Labels beneath clothing, occlusions, interpolation and side conventions retain dataset uncertainty.
selection: Six equally spaced numeric sequence IDs per original train flag, fixed before native model inference. No post-hoc clip rejection based on model error.

limits: These are twelve native sequences, not twelve verified unique subjects. Unknown source/subject identities stay unassigned, and no held-out generalization claim is made.

Some published left/right names appear opposite anatomical/image expectations across views. Literal native mapping is retained, not swapped to minimize prediction error. Report this as native-label disagreement until convention audit resolves it.
No bounding-box oracle or native reference pose is supplied to the estimator; multiple predicted people remain ambiguous in the scorer.
No temporal/endpoint or rep-validity labels are created. Image sequences use frame indices, never invented FPS.
Commercial training/use rights and redistribution rights are not established by this narrow benchmark record.
The selected set contains pull-ups only, no parallel-bar-dip evaluation.
